Sword & Shield series · BST

Battle Styles

Released March 19, 2021 · 183 cards

Expanded

Battle Styles is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on March 19, 2021. Its main set has 163 cards, plus 20 secret rares numbered beyond the set (183 in total). It includes 146 Pokémon, 33 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

72 illustrators worked on Battle Styles. Most cards: PLANETA Mochizuki (14), PLANETA Tsuji (10), Eske Yoshinob (5), 5ban Graphics (4), Ayaka Yoshida (4), HYOGONOSUKE (4), kawayoo (4), Miki Tanaka (4).
